description: Recorded tech-layer scores for the synthetic corpus, measured at the commit below. These are OBSERVED values, not targets: the manifest's expected_score_range is a separate published claim that the implementation does not currently meet. This file locks the pipeline against unintended drift and must be re-recorded deliberately whenever markers, weights or the spaCy pinning change.
tolerance_rationale: Measured, not guessed. Repeated runs in one process are bit-identical, and Python 3.12 and 3.13 produce identical scores on all 24 samples, so observed variance is exactly zero. The smallest real change measured — removing one marker from one set — moves affected samples by ~0.04; a one-unit weight change moves them by ~0.01. A tolerance of 1e-6 sits ~4 orders below the smallest real signal and ~7 above float-ordering noise, so it catches genuine drift without flapping.
